set.body:
Reuse bd-01M02N4CCS9425KPD4S0A0S9HX for human-annotated detector benchmarking. Its admitted corpus is not completed event scoring or scientific qualification. This workstream adds paired comparator evaluation and explicit acceptance.

Acceptance:
- Admit reproducible human-annotated corpora spanning static images, reading and dynamic/pursuit content; identify versions, licenses/hashes, label ontology, annotator disagreement and unsupported/missing coverage. No invented consensus labels, clocks, centre or peak-velocity references.
- Freeze matching, onset/offset convention, boundary tolerance, one-to-one event assignment, tuning versus held-out evaluation, per-class/stimulus aggregation, unavailable metrics and practical scientific pass/noninferiority/improvement thresholds before evaluating.
- Evaluate eyes4s and pinned pymovements with scientifically justified, equally available tuning. Report precision/recall/F1, boundary errors, duration/count bias and reference-supported spatial/velocity metrics, plus controlled noise, dropout and sampling-rate degradation. Report uncertainty by independent recording/participant rather than treating correlated samples as independent replication.
- Distinguish implementation conformance from empirical validity. The existing 0.26.2 oracle fixtures do not establish current 0.28.0 equivalence; retain named I-DT dispersion/violating-sample and half-open-boundary differences rather than erasing them to improve scores.
- Demonstrate predeclared scientific adequacy, no material degradation across mandatory strata, and meaningful improvement in the designated robustness/accuracy targets. Keep failed or unsupported strata open; aggregate success cannot hide a failed class or stimulus family.
- For QC, AOI/reading and comparative measures, add independent hand/reference cases for their estimands and missingness/accounting policies. Scoring/adapters include non-vacuous failure fixtures; new law suites follow the repository mutation requirement. Report JVM/JS conformance where supported.

Final evidence is machine-readable and bound to clean source/tree, exact inputs, methods and configurations. Neither type safety, corpus admission, oracle agreement nor tracker closure alone proves real-data validity.
set.title: PM5: demonstrate empirical accuracy and robustness against independent evidence
